# Items controls markup reference

ItemsControl, ListBox, ComboBox, and navigation lists.

### NavigationView

Receiver: `NavigationView`.

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `CompactPaneWidth(double value)` | `CompactPaneWidth` | Sets the pane width in the compact icon rail. |
| `FooterItems(IReadOnlyList<T> items, Func<T, string> textSelector = null, Func<T, PathGeometry> icon = null, Func<T, Element> content = null, Func<T, NavigationItemKind> kind = null, Func<T, object> keySelector = null)` |  | Sets the footer list's items, template and FooterContentSelector from the items and the selectors, with arbitrary Element icons; a returned instance cannot be shared by rows at the same time. |
| `FooterItems(IReadOnlyList<T> items, Func<T, string> textSelector, Func<T, Element> icon, Func<T, Element> content = null, Func<T, NavigationItemKind> kind = null, Func<T, object> keySelector = null)` |  | Configures bottom-pinned footer items with arbitrary Element icons. A returned instance cannot be shared by rows at the same time. |
| `IsPaneOpen(bool value = true)` | `IsPaneOpen` | Sets whether the pane is expanded (an icon rail when inline, hidden when overlaid). |
| `IsPaneToggleButtonVisible(bool value = true)` | `IsPaneToggleButtonVisible` | Sets whether the toggle button is shown; hiding it pins the pane to its current state. |
| `Items(IReadOnlyList<T> items, Func<T, string> textSelector = null, Func<T, PathGeometry> icon = null, Func<T, Element> content = null, Func<T, NavigationItemKind> kind = null, Func<T, object> keySelector = null)` |  | Sets the pane list's items, template and ContentSelector from the items and the selectors, with optional PathGeometry icons; without a text selector an item's label is its ToString(). |
| `Items(IReadOnlyList<T> items, Func<T, string> textSelector, Func<T, Element> icon, Func<T, Element> content = null, Func<T, NavigationItemKind> kind = null, Func<T, object> keySelector = null)` |  | Sets the pane list's items, template and ContentSelector from the items and the selectors, with arbitrary Element icons; a returned instance cannot be shared by rows at the same time, and text is hidden when the pane is compact. |
| `OnEffectivePaneDisplayModeChanged(Action handler)` | `event EffectivePaneDisplayModeChanged` | Subscribes handler to EffectivePaneDisplayModeChanged. Occurs after EffectivePaneDisplayMode changes, once the layout pass that resolved it has finished, so a handler may invalidate layout without re-entering it. |
| `OnSelectionChanged(Action<object> handler)` | `event SelectionChanged` | Subscribes handler to SelectionChanged. Occurs when the selection changes. |
| `PaneDisplayMode(PaneDisplayMode value)` | `PaneDisplayMode` | Sets the requested pane placement; Auto resolves from the width. |
| `PaneWidth(double value)` | `PaneWidth` | Sets the expanded pane width. |
| `SelectedIndex(int value)` | `SelectedIndex` | Sets the selected item index (-1 = none). |
| `WithContentSelector(Func<object, Element> value)` | `ContentSelector` | Sets the selector mapping the selected item to its content element, which is cached per item. |
| `WithFooterContentSelector(Func<object, Element> value)` | `FooterContentSelector` | Sets the selector mapping a selected footer item to its content element. |

### ItemsControl

Receiver: `ItemsControl`.

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `ClearContainer(PrepareContainerHandler<ItemContainer, T> clear)` |  | Releases what PrepareContainer attached outside the template context, before the container takes another item. |
| `FixedHeightPresenter()` |  | Uses fixed-height row virtualization with theme default item height. |
| `FixedHeightPresenter(ItemsAnchor anchor)` |  | Uses fixed-height row virtualization anchored to the given viewport edge. |
| `FixedHeightPresenter(double itemHeight)` |  | Uses fixed-height row virtualization with explicit item height. |
| `FixedHeightPresenter(double itemHeight, ItemsAnchor anchor)` |  | Uses fixed-height row virtualization with explicit item height, anchored to the given viewport edge. |
| `ItemHeight(double value)` | `ItemHeight` | Sets the height of each item in DIPs; NaN uses the theme default. |
| `ItemPadding(Thickness value)` | `ItemPadding` | Sets the padding for each item. |
| `ItemTemplate(Func<TemplateContext, FrameworkElement> build, Action<FrameworkElement, TItem, int, TemplateContext> bind, Action<FrameworkElement, TItem, int, TemplateContext> unbind = null)` |  | Sets the item template using delegate-based templating. |
| `ItemTemplate(Func<TemplateContext, TElement> build, Action<TElement, TItem, int, TemplateContext> bind, Action<TElement, TItem, int, TemplateContext> unbind = null)` |  | Sets the item template; the bind callback receives the root the build callback returned. |
| `ItemTemplate(Func<TemplateContext, TElement> build, Action<TElement, TItem> bind)` |  | Sets the item template from a root element and a bind callback that needs only the item. |
| `ItemTemplate(IDataTemplate value)` | `ItemTemplate` | Sets the item template; unset, a default label template is used. |
| `Items(IReadOnlyList<T> items, Func<T, string> textSelector = null)` |  | Sets ItemsSource to a view over the items, with an optional text selector. |
| `Items(params string[] items)` |  | Sets ItemsSource to a view over the strings. |
| `ItemsSource(IItemsView itemsSource)` | `ItemsSource` | Sets the items source. |
| `PrepareContainer(PrepareContainerHandler<ItemContainer, T> prepare)` |  | Configures the container of each item once its content is bound. The container is the ItemContainer the items control places around every item. |
| `StackPresenter()` |  | Uses non-virtualizing stack layout (all items realized). |
| `StackPresenter(ItemsAnchor anchor)` |  | Uses non-virtualizing stack layout anchored to the given viewport edge. |
| `VariableHeightPresenter()` |  | Uses variable-height virtualization (items are measured individually). |
| `VariableHeightPresenter(ItemsAnchor anchor)` |  | Uses variable-height virtualization anchored to the given viewport edge. |
| `WrapPresenter(double itemWidth, double itemHeight)` |  | Uses wrap-grid virtualization with fixed item size. |
